name: direct-structured-topology-construction-v3
purpose: Validate deterministic O(cells*fanout) construction for group, mixed-membership, and spatial human-cell architectures.
notes: This is an explicit structured-topology protocol break from topology v2; prior artifacts remain tied to their original candidate-weighted builders.
Builders draw directly from micro/meso memberships or bounded coordinate offsets plus sparse long links and never allocate or score N candidates per source.
Every result is built in a fresh process and checked for fixed degree, range, no self-edge, and no duplicate edge per source.
